story.title: Freshworks Cuts 11% of Workforce as AI Reshapes Indian-Founded Software Sector
story.summary: Freshworks, the Indian-founded SaaS giant now headquartered in the US, has announced it will cut approximately 11% of its global workforce as AI tools increasingly automate tasks previously handled by human employees. The company cited the rapid adoption of AI-driven software development and support tools as a structural driver of the restructuring. The cuts signal a broader pattern in the Indian-origin tech industry where AI productivity gains are directly translating into workforce reductions.
